title: Here are the top 10 signs it’s AI writing, and the prompt to fix it! #ai #aiwritting #aiprompt
description: Here are the top 10 signs it’s AI writing, and the prompt to fix it! #ai #aiwritting #aiprompt #aitips #chatgptprompts
transcript: Here are the 10 signs the AI obviously wrote something and the one prompt that fixes every single one of them. The first one is the M dashes, that long hyphen that's just all over the place. Number two is using formal words you wouldn't use in conversation. Number three is saying it's not X, it's Y, making some comparison that you wouldn't normally make. Number four is the rule of three or listicles when it doesn't need to be there. Number five is stiff transitions where you go from one topic to the next without any kind of transition. Number six is the filler openers like I hope this finds you well. Number seven is having the same length conversations and lengthy emails or documents. Number eight is bullet points in DMs making it way too formal. Number nine is repetitive summary at the end of your writing. Number 10 is when it's perfect grammar but no real voice. Here's the prompt you use to fix it. Save this video and follow for more.
